As an Event Coordinator, I want to be notified when my booking request is approved or rejected (with reason), so that I can continue planning without delay.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Coordinator is notified when status changes.
* Rejection notification includes the reason provided by Venue Staff.

Note: confirmed 2026-09-06 as the sole owner of the venue-booking-decision notification — a duplicate bullet in "User is notified on coordinator assignment" (SCRUM-46) was removed to avoid two stories independently delivering the same notification.
